### [Contribute to the Football Manager Update](https://sortitoutsi.net/football-manager-data-update/contribute "Update Football Manager")

Our Football Manager Transfer Update is a **community effort** built by fans of Football Manager just like you.

**Anybody can submit changes** and request that they be included in our Football Manager Data Update so if you find something that is out of date, get involved!

Read the editing guide: [Editing Guide](https://sortitoutsi.net/content/59230/how-to-contribute-to-the-sortitoutsi-data-update)

Watch the editing video tutorial: [Editing Video Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?sub_confirmation=1&v=BOk2kYV__S0)

View our [contributors leaderboard](https://sortitoutsi.net/football-manager-data-update/contributors).

You can [search for something you want to edit](https://sortitoutsi.net/search/database) or just use the quick search below.

Or if you want to know what's updated, you can [browse our Football Manager Update](https://sortitoutsi.net/football-manager-data-update/database) with our updated data including latest transfers and new contracts.

You can find anything you need this way, e.g. looking for Harry Kane? Just go to Europe > England > Premier Division > Tottenham > Harry Kane

**NEW! Submit Player Attributes and New Players**

You can now submit new players that aren't in the default version of FM. In particular we are looking for new youth players aged 14-17. You can also make suggestions for any CA/PA changes you think should be made to existing players.

Click the button below to get started.

[Submit Players and Attributes](https://sortitoutsi.net/football-manager-data-update/attributes)

**Contribute External Sources**

You can also help out alot by helping us build a database of links to other platforms such as FotMob, FBRef, TransferMarkt, Wikipedia, Twitter or any helpful site.

All you have to visit the [Profile Manager](https://sortitoutsi.net/football-manager-data-update/profiles) and begin adding sources for every competition, team and player.

Simply click the links in the first column to navigate via Continent > Nation > Competition > Team > Player and then add the relevant URL in the appropriate field.

Anyone who contributes 200 changes will qualify to get any paid versions of the updates for free.

## [How to install a Football Manager Data Update](http://sortitoutsi.net/football-manager-data-update#install_data_update "How to install Football Manager Transfer Update")

You might also be interested in [this football manager transfer update installation tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?sub_confirmation=1&v=YfyfJ7dFItU) on YouTube.

1.   Delete any previous version of our Football Manager 26 Data Update you may have installed before you start
2.   Download the zip file to your computer using the "Download" button
3.   Extract the zip file
4.    Find the "fmf" files within extract files and move them to the following location (create the "editor data" folder if it doesn't exist) 
    *   **Windows:** My Documents/Sports Interactive/Football Manager 26/editor data/
    *   **Mac:** /Users/YOURNAME/Library/Application Support/Sports Interactive/Football Manager 26/editor data/

5.   Make sure you don't have any sub folders under "editor data". All ".fmf" files should be directly under the "editor data" folder.
6.   Start Football Manager 26 and select "New Career Game"
7.   If you're having issues check out our [Data Update Installation Troubleshooting Page](https://sortitoutsi.net/content/62063/troubleshooting-football-manager-data-update-installation-how-to-install-football-manager-databases)
